topic: A neighbor asks to use part of the yard for a garden
text: I remember when the yard was just a place where the sun fell and the wind whispered, a space that held quiet promises and soft memories. Now, my neighbor has approached me, asking to use a portion of it for a garden. It’s a lovely idea, really, and I can see the kindness in their eyes, the hopeful smile that gently pulls at the corners of their mouth. A garden could bring so much life, so much color. Yet, as I listen to their words, I find myself looking down at the very grass they wish to till, at the soil that has always been here, unchanged and peaceful. I nod slowly, trying to muster a smile, wishing the decision felt as bright and as hopeful as the garden they envision.
